```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
Estimated_tariff_impact <- read_csv(here("data","Estimated_Impact_Trump_Tariffs.csv"))
Revenue_effects <- read_csv(here("data", "Revenue_Effects_Trump_Tariffs.csv"))
```

```{r}
Estimated_tariff_impact <- Estimated_tariff_impact |>
  mutate(country = ...1) |>
  select(country, GDP, `Capital Stock`, `Pre-Tax Wages`,`Hours Worked Converted to Full-Time Equivalent Jobs`, )
```

```{r}
Revenue_effects |>
  mutate(country = `Conventional Revenue`) |>
  select(-`Conventional Revenue`) |>
  relocate(country, .before = `2025`)
```
